Premium Drones Georgia is the official and exclusive XAG dealer in the Caucasus.

XAG is a world leader in manufacturing agricultural drones and robots. Its team was formed in 2007–2008, and its main goal is to build the infrastructure of agriculture for the next 100 years.

About XAG →

XAG P150 MAX — one platform, four jobs

Mapping. Spraying. Spreading. Cargo.

  1. 01

    Mapping

    30 ha

    Mapped per flight

    The drone maps the field by itself with its high-resolution camera — no separate mapping drone needed. Built-in AI recognises obstacles automatically and marks them on the map.

  2. 02

    Spraying

    80 L

    Spray tank

    Precise spraying across a 5–10 m swath, with two pumps delivering up to 32 L/min. With the 4-nozzle upgrade kit (sold separately), up to 46 L/min for orchards and vineyards.

  3. 03

    Granule spreading

    115 L

    Granule container

    With the RevoCast 5 module (sold separately): fertiliser, seed and other granules, up to 9 m effective width.

  4. 04

    Cargo transport

    80 kg

    Max payload

    With the RevoSling system (sold separately): deliver materials and equipment to hard-to-reach places.
